notes.title: 🛠️ UPDATE 1.3.1.0 - SANDBOX STAGES
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have some nice new features for Common’hood; New Stages for the Multiplayer and Sandbox modes of the game. Now you can finally play creative mode in any of the areas of the factory; West wing, Pumping Grounds, Machine Room, Factory Entrance, Green House, Barren Lands and the Shipyard. You can build creations in these locations with your friends in multiplayer. We have also continued fixing bugs based on the feedback we have received. See below the update notes, we hope you enjoy the update.

🌱- New Sandbox and Multiplayer stages
🌱- Hold to pack feature (pack any machine, blueprint, or custom object)
🌱- Quick swap between UI/inventory panels on the controller (d-pad)
🌱- Inventory overflow (receiving items with a full inventory) now spawns boxes with the items
🌱- Split the look sensitivity slider into X and Y components
🌱- Blueprint breakdown now works on the controller as well (hold X and then L trigger)

⚖️- Lost in-world key items now respawn if not detected in player inventories 
⚖️- Solar panels no longer depend on light levels. They now work like a consistent generator without the fuel costs


🐞- Fixed save panel input field not working
🐞- Crops now save their growth in other regions properly
🐞- Added additional safeguards for saving key items
🐞- Fixed settings dropdowns to display appropriate selections
🐞- The research panel now displays unlocked tech regardless of the tech level of the bench used
🐞- Blueprint aux panel steps list now scrolls on the controller

notes.title: 🛠️UPDATE 1.2.16.0 - Controller Support
notes.content:
We are finally bringing all the recent console updates to Steam, including controller support and major improvements to gameplay, optimization, and many bug fixes. We are planning to continue developing updates based on the feedback we are getting on Discord. If you are not part of our discord community, you can join it with this link:
https://discord.gg/2rgYBADm5j


Here are the updates included in this patch:

🌱- Marketplace controller support overhaul:
	🌱--On tap left / right triggers add / subtract 1 respectively from quick buy total
	🌱--On hold left / right trigger, add / subtract 10 respectively every 1.2 seconds
	🌱--Hold A to buy / sell
	🌱--LB switches to buy tab (and moves cursor to buy window)
	🌱--RB switches to sell tab (and moves cursor to player inventory)
🌱- Added look sensitivity slider
🌱-New language support: Traditional Chinese
🌱-New lighting setup for Main Lobby

⚡- Icons now swap between controller and mouse even more effectively
⚡- Increased text size of hover tips
⚡- Performance improvements to the opening of inventory panels
⚡- Improvements to robot blueprint loading with controller

🐞- Fixed scrolling through blueprints on controller
🐞- Fixed an issue with the end of day sleep cutscene freezing
🐞- Fixed an issue causing the save/load panel to not display any previous saves
🐞- Removed an invisible concrete pile that was preventing building in certain parts of the Glass House
🐞- Removed ability to delete key items from inventory
🐞- Fixed hover text appearing when hovering mouse over change buy quantity arrows in market panel
🐞- Fixed minor backend bug when pressing bumpers in market panel
🐞- Machines now properly save/load if they are active and building
🐞- Fixed issue with accidentally being able to pick up machines that contained items
🐞- Fixed an issue where NPCs or robots completing an order could break your blueprints
🐞- Fixed certain hover tips overflowing the screen
🐞- Fixed create blueprint achievement from triggering to early
🐞- Fixed breakdown blueprint action on controller

We felt that many players were experiencing performance issues, so hopefully, this helps. We have also been chasing many bugs that have been difficult to replicate, as they are error states that we have not seen on our end. Specifically, we have been working on the “End of Day” bug, and we have done many corrections and improvements that we think might fix some of the issues, but we are still trying to get to the bottom of it, so please let us know if issues persist.

⚡- Performance improvements to Barren Lands

notes.title: New details about the upcoming multiplayer update!
notes.content:
Hello Common’hood Community!

We know it’s been a while since our last update, but we want to assure everyone that development has been healthy and active. We would like to thank our testing team on [url=https://discord.gg/MJc3gmf]Discord[/url] for working extremely hard to ensure all players have the best experience possible when playing Common’hood. We love seeing the thriving communities that those who have already jumped into the game have built. Those of you who are still waiting patiently, we can’t wait to see your amazing creations.

As you may have read, we have been able to upgrade our capabilities, allowing us to welcome a professional QA team to our workflow. Together, we have been able to work on and fix a ton of small polish issues with the game. Delivering the best version of Common’hood to players has always been our number one priority and we hope that everyone is impressed with these changes and updates.

We are excited about the upcoming multiplayer update and wanted to give players more of an idea of what they can expect when they head into the game with their friends later this year.  The first version of multiplayer that will be available to try will be an extension of our sandbox environment. It will give players the chance to build and design with their friends. No limit on materials gives players infinite possibilities. Once you’re done designing you can save your project and share it with either the Common’hood community online or in your single-player story mode.

We appreciate the support from all of those who have been keeping up with us in [url=https://discord.gg/MJc3gmf]Discord[/url], wishlisting the game, testing out the updates, and giving us valuable feedback. It is because of you that we are able to do this and bring Common’hood to life. Look out for even more updates coming soon!

notes.title: Polish, Polish, Polish!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BqvPt1U.jpg[/img]

The Common’hood team is back to give you an update on development and our upcoming release. Our full-time work on the game has continued since our last message and we’re happy to say Common’hood is really close to release.

The last few months have been dedicated to polish as well as building our sandbox multiplayer mode. In the Multiplayer Sandbox you will be able to play alongside your friends, design and build to your collective creativity’s desire with unlimited materials. This mode is not only great for creative expression, but it’ll allow you to create blueprints to share with other players or use in the Story mode.

Common’hood has grown to become a larger game than what we anticipated, which has us excited but at the same time there has been a lot of polish necessary for reaching the standard that we think you deserve. So, we are not there yet, but we are getting closer. 

This are the mayor updates that we have finished recently:

[list]
[*] Completion of the campaign
[*] Online Multiplayer Sandbox
[*] Upgraded character models
[*] Upgrades to NPCs AI.
[*] Upgrades to Pathfining.
[*] Final OST  
[*] Campaign Blueprints
[*] Rebalance for tech progression / economy
[/list]

We are currently working with our QA partners to polish all the hundreds of details that are necessary to reach a finished product. We want to reassure you that we are working hard on having the game ready as soon as possible and we will be announcing our release date as soon as we feel that we have a finished product.

We are planning to do some network testing in the coming weeks so please join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/Bud8bv36hw]Discord[/url] if you would like to take part.

notes.title: Common'hood Closed Beta Two - Freeform - is now On!
notes.content:
The wait is over, time for the next Beta phase! We heard your feedback loud and clear, and besides stomping down on the bugs you helped us find, we’ve focused our work on improving the game’s construction systems. Thus we’ve implemented:


[list]
[*] Upgraded building system: More responsive, cleaner and stuffed full of new possibilities
[*] Online blueprint sharing: Use the in-game database and share your creations with other players - We will be selecting from this to create the default database for every player at launch!
[*] Custom blueprint creation: We’re really dedicated to tearing down all creativity barriers!
[*] New Materials & ways to build: Let your imagination be the limit, not the tools in your hands!
[*] Infinite Sandbox Stockpile: It’s bigger on the inside. Not available in story mode.
[*] Automation system: Free your settlers, let robots do the hard, repetitive work!
[*] Bug-fixes and changes galore: Made possible thanks to the feedback you gave us!
[/list]

Help us test them out! What kind of awesome buildings and furniture will you make and share in our online blueprint system? Which materials will you choose? Have we made the building process intuitive and smooth enough? 

All of this will be answered on Beta 2! Wanna sign up? Get a steam key by following the steps below:

1 -  join our Discord at:
https://discord.gg/SrCPgQz

2 - Once you’re in there, hop into any of the public channels and type out:
“i want to test” 
(in any channel)

notes.content:
Common’hood Closed Beta Two - Freeform - will open on June 7th! If you haven’t signed up, there’s no better time than now! Do it here: http://eepurl.com/gP1z6H

In this Beta we’re taking a sidestep from the story mode to dive into Sandbox for the very first time! Not only that, but you’ll also find...
[list]
[*] Upgraded building system: More responsive, cleaner and stuffed full of new possibilities
[*] Online blueprint sharing: Use the ingame database and share your creations with other players - We will be selecting from this to create the default database for every player at launch!
[*] Custom blueprint creation: We’re really dedicated to tearing down all creativity barriers!
[*] New Materials & ways to build: Let your imagination be the limit, not the tools in your hands!
[*] Infinite Sandbox Stockpile: It’s bigger on the inside. Not available in story mode.
[*] Automation system: Free your settlers, let robots do the hard, repetitive work!

Like before, once Closed Beta Two opens up we’ll spend time looking into data, individual issues and all sorts of feedback. In this period we’ll implement smaller balance and bug-fixing related changes while gathering feedback before we take it back to the shop and get to work. 

We once again thank you for your incredible support and we thank you for your help with making Common’hood the best game it can be!

notes.title: Public Demo 2 Disabled Now
notes.content:
This article is now outdated as the demo has been disabled, body of article preserved in transparency's sake.
-------
The sandbox demo is finally out!! 

The demo can be accessed via our discord channel:
https://discord.gg/BTSzvZz

A few things to note:
- The sandbox will be available once you complete the story. That is - if you have a save where you repaired the crane and built the bridge, it will automatically and retroactively be unlocked.
- Two big new features we've been working on are also playable: tech tree and blueprint viewer. We hope the game itself will do a good job walking you through it :)
- There's a new way to plant! I want to mention this here since it's not in the tutorials yet. If you equip seeds/water you can plant or water planters by simply clicking on them.
- We've also included fixes to a bunch of the bugs reported a few weeks ago. Planter bugs, stuck in chair bugs, etc.
- We've activated our subreddit as an alternative for bug reporting now, so feel free to use it if that's your thing: 
https://www.reddit.com/r/commonhood/comments/f2e33i/official_bug_reports_thread/
I personally feel that a reddit thread is easier for archiving.

Happy testing! 
All feedbacks are appreciated
